capabilities: Export notes to DOCX, PDF, ePub, HTML, PowerPoint and LaTeX via Pandoc
Run exports from the command palette
Use Pandoc templates and citations in exports
Combine multiple documents into one output
extras: Documentation on templates, citations, troubleshooting and installation lives on an external wiki, not in the README. The author warns the plugin is in beta with frequent minor formatting issues and recommends proof-reading output.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert Markdown notes into Word documents, ebooks, PDFs or other document formats for sharing or submission.

relations.evidence: This is all thanks to Pandoc.

summary: Pandoc export plugin that adds command palette commands to export notes to DOCX, PDF, ePub, HTML, PowerPoint, LaTeX and other Pandoc-supported formats.
